svg.title: Leaving for the browser and coming back

g.text: Leaving for the browser and coming back
An embedded webview cannot serve an authorization page, so anything that needs a real browser opens in one and returns on the build's URL scheme.
Only the sign-in callback is handled before the router exists; every other link is a route the app navigates to.
Staging is the same picture on the manor-staging scheme, so a link for one build never opens the other.
